item.title: Bois Blanc by Arabiyat Prestige – 1ml Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Inspiration: Bois Impérial by Essential Parfums
Type:
Price: 2.25

Overview

Fresh, vibrant, and smoothly woody, Bois Blanc by Arabiyat Prestige is a citrus-aromatic fragrance that blends sparkling grapefruit, lively spices, soft florals, and modern amber woods. It opens with a bright combination of grapefruit, pink pepper, and elemi resin, delivering a crisp citrus introduction with a peppery bite and a cool, slightly balsamic freshness.

As it develops, violet and lily of the valley introduce a clean, airy floral character, while dry amber adds warmth and structure without making the fragrance feel heavy. The dry-down settles into earthy patchouli and a smooth ambergris accord, leaving a clean, woody-amber trail with a mineral-like freshness and polished depth.

Bois Blanc delivers a sparkling grapefruit-and-pepper opening with a smooth amber, patchouli, and woody base—fresh, modern, and effortlessly sophisticated.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Pink Pepper, Elemi Resin, Grapefruit
Middle: Violet, Lily of the Valley, Dry Amber
Base: Patchouli, Ambergris Accord

Inspired & Occasion

Bois Blanc sits in the fresh citrus / aromatic woody-amber lane and is commonly compared to Bois Impérial by Essential Parfums. It carries a similar modern, airy woodiness, but Bois Blanc adds a brighter grapefruit opening, softer floral touches, and a smoother ambergris-style base. Some fragrance enthusiasts also notice elements of the fresh grapefruit-amber style associated with fragrances such as Bvlgari Tygar and Sospiro Vibrato.

It’s highly versatile and works especially well for office wear, business meetings, casual outings, vacations, dinners, and warm-weather evenings. The citrus and aromatic opening make it refreshing during spring and summer, while the amber, patchouli, and woody dry-down provide enough depth for year-round use.

This falls into the “modern clean signature scent” category—bright and peppery up top, airy and refined through the middle, then smooth, woody, and ambery in the dry-down.

Try Before You Commit

The fragrance opens with a sharp burst of grapefruit and pink pepper, creating a sparkling citrus effect with a fresh spicy edge. Elemi resin adds a clean, balsamic quality that makes the opening feel crisp, cool, and slightly mineral.

Within 15–20 minutes, violet, lily of the valley, and dry amber begin to soften the brighter opening, creating a smoother and more refined character. As it dries down, patchouli introduces an earthy woody depth while the ambergris accord creates a clean, warm, and lingering finish.

Try it first with a Decantified sample and experience the full evolution before committing to a full bottle.

item.title: Odyssey Soda Pop by Armaf – 1ml Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Inspiration: Chilled Cola Soda
Type:
Price: 1.99

Overview

Fizzy, spicy, and playfully addictive, Odyssey Soda Pop by Armaf is a citrus-gourmand fragrance that blends chilled cola, fresh citrus, cooling herbs, warm spices, and creamy vanilla woods. It opens with an energetic combination of citruses, ginger, lavender, mint, and a chilling cola accord, delivering a sparkling soda-like introduction that feels sweet, refreshing, and slightly spicy.

As it develops, black tea, cinnamon bark, nutmeg, and neroli create a warmer, more aromatic heart. The spices deepen the cola effect while black tea introduces a slightly dry character that balances the sweetness. The dry-down settles into bourbon vanilla, tonka bean, amberwood, sandalwood, patchouli, olibanum, white musk, and benzoin, leaving a smooth, warm, and resinous trail with creamy sweetness and woody depth.

Odyssey Soda Pop delivers a sparkling citrus-cola opening with a warm vanilla, amber, and woody base—playful, nostalgic, and attention-grabbing.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Citruses, Ginger, Lavender, Mint, Chilling Cola
Middle: Neroli, Cinnamon Bark, Nutmeg, Black Tea
Base: Bourbon Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Amberwood, Sandalwood, Patchouli, Olibanum, White Musk, Benzoin

Inspired & Occasion

Odyssey Soda Pop sits in the fizzy citrus / spicy gourmand lane, inspired by the experience of opening a cold, carbonated soda. Rather than recreating one specific designer fragrance, it builds its personality around a recognizable chilled-cola accord layered with citrus, cooling mint, ginger, black tea, warm spices, vanilla, and woods. Armaf describes the fragrance as a lighter, more energetic interpretation of gourmand perfumery rather than a heavy dessert-style scent.

It’s versatile enough for casual year-round wear but works especially well for evenings, social events, dates, parties, and cooler days when the vanilla, spices, and amber woods can fully develop. The cooling citrus, mint, and cola opening also gives it enough freshness for spring and warm-weather nights.

This falls into the “playful modern gourmand” category—fizzy and refreshing up top, spicy and aromatic through the middle, then warm, sweet, and woody in the dry-down.

Try Before You Commit

The fragrance opens with a sparkling rush of cola, citrus, ginger, and mint, creating the impression of a freshly opened soda with a cool, fizzy bite. Lavender adds a clean aromatic touch that keeps the opening from smelling overly sugary.

Within 15–20 minutes, black tea, cinnamon, nutmeg, and neroli begin to emerge, making the fragrance feel warmer, spicier, and more sophisticated. As it dries down, bourbon vanilla and tonka bean add creamy sweetness while amberwood, sandalwood, patchouli, olibanum, musk, and benzoin create a smooth, resinous foundation.

Try it first with a Decantified sample and experience the full evolution before committing to a full bottle.

item.title: Club de Nuit Intense Overdose by Armaf – 1ml Sample Decant
item.description:

Overview

Fruity, sweet, and intensely masculine, Club de Nuit Intense Overdose by Armaf is a citrus-amber fragrance that takes the recognizable Club de Nuit Intense DNA in a richer, smoother, and more addictive direction. It opens with a vibrant combination of bergamot, tangerine, pineapple, and a blue crystal accord, delivering a juicy citrus-fruity introduction with a bright, almost sparkling freshness.

As it develops, plum and vanilla flower add a deeper fruity sweetness, while oakmoss brings an earthy green quality that balances the brighter opening. The dry-down settles into patchouli, tonka bean, and soft powdery notes, leaving a warm, sweet, and slightly earthy trail with a smooth masculine finish. Armaf describes Overdose as an intensified version of its signature Club de Nuit Intense DNA, created with a bolder presence and fuller character.

Club de Nuit Intense Overdose delivers a sparkling pineapple-citrus opening with a sweet plum, oakmoss, and tonka base—bold, modern, and built to stand out.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Bergamot, Tangerine, Pineapple, Blue Crystal Accord
Middle: Vanilla Flower, Oakmoss, Plum
Base: Patchouli, Tonka Bean, White Powder

Inspired & Occasion

Club de Nuit Intense Overdose sits in the fruity citrus / sweet amber-woody lane, presenting a richer and sweeter evolution of the famous Club de Nuit Intense Man style. It keeps the bright pineapple and citrus character associated with Creed Aventus-inspired fragrances but replaces much of the original’s smoky birch character with plum, vanilla flower, tonka bean, and a smoother powdery sweetness. This comparison is an interpretation based on Overdose building upon Armaf’s original Club de Nuit Intense DNA.

It’s versatile enough for year-round wear but shines especially well during evenings, dates, parties, nights out, and cooler weather. The sparkling citrus opening keeps it energetic, while the sweet plum, earthy oakmoss, and warm tonka base give it enough richness for nighttime wear.

This falls into the “bold fruity compliment scent” category—bright and juicy up top, sweet and earthy through the middle, then warm, smooth, and slightly powdery in the dry-down.

Try Before You Commit

The fragrance opens with a strong burst of pineapple, tangerine, and bergamot, creating a juicy tropical-citrus effect with a cool, crystalline freshness. Within 15–20 minutes, plum and vanilla flower begin to soften the brighter opening, adding a darker fruitiness and smooth sweetness.

As it dries down, oakmoss and patchouli introduce an earthy, masculine depth while tonka bean and powdery notes create a warmer, softer finish. The result is a sweeter and more polished take on the Club de Nuit Intense style, built for noticeable presence without relying as heavily on the original’s smoky character.

Try it first with a Decantified sample and experience the full evolution before committing to a full bottle.

As it develops, cashmere wood, caramel, nutmeg, cloves, and guaiac wood create a warm, textured heart that feels creamy, spicy, and slightly smoky. The dry-down settles into vanilla woods, sandalwood, moss, and dry amber, leaving a smooth, sweet-woody trail with an earthy undertone that keeps the fragrance from becoming overly sugary.

Nitro White Intensely delivers a boozy fruit-and-spice opening with a creamy caramel-wood base—warm, luxurious, and attention-grabbing.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Dark Rum, Apple, Saffron, Pineapple, Cardamom
Middle: Cashmere Wood, Caramel, Nutmeg, Cloves, Guaiac Wood
Base: Vanilla Woods, Sandalwood, Moss, Dry Amber

Inspired & Occasion

Nitro White Intensely sits in the boozy gourmand / warm spicy woody lane. Rather than directly copying one specific fragrance, it presents an original composition built around fruity rum, caramelized spices, creamy woods, vanilla, and amber.

It shines best during fall and winter, especially in the evenings when its warm spices, caramel, vanilla, and amber can fully develop. It’s an excellent choice for date nights, dinners, parties, special occasions, and nights out when you want a fragrance that feels rich and noticeable.

This falls into the “warm seductive compliment scent” category—fruity and boozy up top, sweet and spicy through the middle, then creamy, woody, and ambery in the dry-down.

Try Before You Commit

The fragrance opens with a rich burst of dark rum, pineapple, and apple, creating a sweet boozy effect with saffron and cardamom adding warmth and spice. Within 15–20 minutes, caramel, nutmeg, cloves, and cashmere wood begin to take over, making the fragrance feel smoother, creamier, and more indulgent.

As it dries down, vanilla woods and sandalwood create a soft, creamy foundation while moss and dry amber add warmth, depth, and a slightly earthy finish. The result is a sweet and seductive fragrance that feels luxurious without losing its masculine woody character.

Try it first with a Decantified sample and experience the full evolution before committing to a full bottle.

Middle: Grapefruit Blossom
Base: Calone, Sandalwood

Azul sits in the fresh citrus / aromatic aquatic lane and is inspired by the clean, sparkling character of Dior Homme Cologne. Both fragrances center around bright bergamot and grapefruit blossom, although Azul introduces lemon, calone, and sandalwood to create a slightly more aquatic and woody interpretation.

It shines best during spring and summer, especially on extremely hot days when heavier fragrances can feel overwhelming. It’s an excellent choice for daytime wear, vacations, the beach, outdoor activities, the gym, casual outings, or anytime you want to smell freshly showered and clean.

This falls into the “refreshing summer essential” category—zesty and sparkling up top, airy and floral through the middle, then clean, aquatic, and softly woody in the dry-down.

Try Before You Commit

The fragrance opens with a powerful burst of lemon and bergamot that resembles chilled lemonade with a slightly bitter touch of citrus peel. Within 15–20 minutes, the opening becomes smoother as grapefruit blossom introduces a clean, airy floral character.

As it dries down, calone creates a cool watery effect while sandalwood adds a soft woody foundation. The result is a simple but highly refreshing scent that remains light, clean, and comfortable without becoming overly sweet or heavy.

Try it first with a Decantified sample and experience the full evolution before committing to a full bottle.

Kaaf Noir sits in the fresh spicy / woody aromatic lane, closely compared to K by Dolce & Gabbana Eau de Parfum because of its combination of blood orange, citrus, juniper berries, cardamom, lavender, clary sage, geranium, cedar, vetiver, and patchouli. The similarity is especially noticeable in the bright aromatic opening and dry, masculine woody base.

It’s versatile enough for everyday wear but works especially well for the office, casual outings, dates, dinners, and warm-weather evenings. The fresh citrus and aromatics make it easy to wear during the day, while the woody, musky dry-down gives it enough depth to transition into nighttime.

This falls into the “clean modern signature scent” category—bright and energetic up top, aromatic and masculine through the middle, then smooth, woody, and musky in the dry-down.

Try Before You Commit

The fragrance opens with a sharp burst of blood orange, Sicilian lemon, and juniper berries, creating a fresh citrus effect with a cool, slightly bitter edge. As it dries down, cedarwood, vetiver, ambroxan, and white musk take over, creating a dry, woody-musky base that stays fresh while adding warmth and masculine depth.
